title: Applications for the academic year 2027-2028
field: European studies (law, economics, politics, international relations)
about: The College of Europe accepts applications for its 2027-2028 postgraduate programmes from 14 October 2026 until 13 January 2027; reference letters are due 20 January 2027. Merit-based scholarships and ENP scholarships are awarded after evaluation and an obligatory interview.
requirements: College scholarships are merit-based, after evaluation of the application and an obligatory interview
ENP scholarships for EU nationals are in principle limited to one or two per Member State
